summary: The 42-name menu is clean overall: every candidate has fscore_computable 9, so no score leans on missing tests, and only GRMN and ONC carry a pre-computed flag (amended filings). The best combination of top-of-sector gross profitability, high F-score and cash flow well above net income is VRSN, DPZ and CARG, followed by IDXX and TPR. The main concerns are earnings not backed by cash at DORM (and marginally at GRMN, MLI, WDFC, AAPL), stale fiscal years at CLX, WDFC and AAPL, and several sector labels that look wrong (DPZ, MSCI, MCO, CART, FAST, CVS).
